name: Augury
description:
You've learned to seek meaning in the flight of birds.

Once per long rest, you may spend at least 1 minute observing the flight of birds. Share your interpretation with your companions (in their attentive presence), then select a skill. For the next day, whenever a companion who chooses to believe you rolls the selected skill, the roll is favored. The effect ends if they fail/lose a roll using the selected skill.

Describe your augury.
